METHOD-EXCEPTIONAL-GAUSSIAN-RADIAL-20261.title: Homogenize even exceptional invariants before Gaussian radial transfer
METHOD-EXCEPTIONAL-GAUSSIAN-RADIAL-20261.when: Transferring Gaussian field uniformity,ordinary cutoff ideals or nilpotent lifting to SL2/2O or SL2/2I at fixed matrix-entry degree.
METHOD-EXCEPTIONAL-GAUSSIAN-RADIAL-20261.use: Average representatives over Gamma;use -I to remove odd terms;homogenize using det1. The standard R4 quaternion Gaussian has det=r2 and radial factor2^((Dm+E)/2)((Dm+E)/2+1)!. Average arbitrary Gaussian markers and decompose by homogeneous degree. The factor is a characteristic-zero unit,so ordinary moment/cutoff ideals agree with the pulled-back Gaussian family. Apply existing closed-safe-field and nilpotent results. Before transferring a radial cancellation circuit to a finite SU2 quotient,test whether it requires the ENTIRE two-complex-coordinate factorial law with actual conjugates. The new critical-dimensional theorem forces a sphere covering and excludes that law on EVERY nontrivial finite quotient,even for arbitrary nonlinear coordinates in every degree.
METHOD-EXCEPTIONAL-GAUSSIAN-RADIAL-20261.avoid: Using a bounded list of identities as an all-order proof,averaging a failure phase and assuming purity survives,omitting the Gaussian variance factor,or measuring degree only in invariant generators. Pointwise Haar cutoffs alone did not establish this fixed-degree uniform bridge. Do not assume a coherent highest-weight coordinate pair descends through an arbitrary finite right action,or fit longer finite moment prefixes for a law now excluded globally. Do not identify this quotient-coordinate law with the FOUR-ambient-Gaussian homogenization bridge. Pure alternating circuit equations and holomorphic moments alone do not imply full isotropy.
METHOD-EXCEPTIONAL-GAUSSIAN-RADIAL-20261.boundary: Homogeneity and Reynolds supply the all-order proof;eight exact even-sector controls only check transcription. Safe pure-null phases at fixed degree share a field slope on both quotients,and their safe locus is closed. Gaussian coefficient algorithms remain theoretical. Nilpotent lifting gives thickness-dependent bounds,not ordinary stabilization or a thickness-independent nonreduced bound. Both global MZ decisions remain open and independent review remains outstanding. GRADIALCRITDIM20261116 requires positive compact connected source,actual conjugates and the full mixed moment law;at d=2q-1 it yields a sphere diffeomorphism for q>=2. GFINITESU2RADIALNO20261116 excludes every nontrivial finite SU2 quotient but does NOT exclude arbitrary phase-invariant circuit tables or decide full exceptional MZ. The retained actual radial bridge and real-height scalar theorems remain valid.
